description: The calcaneofibular ligament spans the outer ankle like a taut strap, steadying the heel beneath the fibula for clean gesture drawing of the lower leg.
actions: Resists inversion stress at the subtalar joint during weight shifts.
Links the lateral malleolus to the heel so the fibula and calcaneus move as a team in plantarflexion.
Provides a crisp surface tension along the outer ankle for artists to indicate when the foot is braced.
